title: External Validation of a Widely Implemented Proprietary Sepsis Prediction Model in Hospitalized Patients
supports_claim: External validation found poor discrimination and calibration and quantified missed sepsis cases and alert burden.
limitations: Single health-system retrospective cohort may not generalize to every hospital or model version.

title: Comparison of Diagnostic and Triage Accuracy of Ada Health WebMD ChatGPT and Physicians
supports_claim: The clinical data study reports unsafe triage rates for multiple symptom checkers and ChatGPT versions.
limitations: Small sample and historical model versions limit generalization to this product or current systems.

title: Safety of a large language model-based clinical decision support system in African primary healthcare
supports_claim: Review of 1469 deployed encounters found both harmful recommendations and cases where clinician edits mitigated risk.
limitations: Retrospective findings from clinics in Kenya and a specific workflow do not establish performance in Vietnam.

title: Ethics and governance of artificial intelligence for health
supports_claim: WHO states six principles including autonomy safety transparency accountability inclusiveness and sustainability for AI in health.
limitations: Ethical guidance is not a product-specific validation or binding legal classification.

title: Clinical Decision Support Software Guidance
supports_claim: FDA guidance explains how intended users functions and independent review affect clinical decision-support software treatment.
limitations: United States guidance is not directly applicable to Vietnam or EU deployment.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: The official publication provides the Vietnam AI Law text needed for use-case classification.
limitations: Exact obligations depend on role intended purpose workflow and implementing instruments.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list
supports_claim: The official decision provides the current list used to assess high-risk AI systems in Vietnam.
limitations: The full intended workflow must be matched to the text with legal review.

title: AI Act implementation timeline
supports_claim: The Commission publishes the current timeline for high-risk AI including systems integrated into regulated products.
limitations: Classification and dates may change and medical-device status remains product-specific.
